chapter.en: PART I PRELIMINARY

heading.en: Citation and commencement

text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Casino Control (Entry Levy) Regulations 2010 and shall come into operation on 3rd February 2010.

chapter.en: PART I PRELIMINARY

heading.en: Definitions

chapter.en: PART II PAYMENT OF ENTRY LEVY

heading.en: Manner in which entry levy is to be paid

chapter.en: PART II PAYMENT OF ENTRY LEVY

heading.en: Pre-payment of entry levy

text.en:
4.—(1) A casino operator may collect an entry levy from a resident in advance of the resident entering its casino premises, the validity period of which starts on the earlier of the following:
(a)the first entry of the resident to its casino premises after the collection of the entry levy;
(b)6 hours after the time of the collection of the entry levy.
[S 513/2019 wef 01/08/2019]
(2) A casino operator must not —
(a)change the time delimited by paragraph (1) for the start of the validity period of an entry levy collected in advance; or
(b)collect any entry levy from a resident while the resident has a right to enter its casino premises, by reason of having previously paid an entry levy (whether before, on or after 1 August 2019) which has a remaining validity period of more than 6 hours.
[S 513/2019 wef 01/08/2019]
(3) Any entry levy that has been paid shall not be refundable, in whole or in part, even if the resident who paid the entry levy does not enter or remain on the casino premises during the validity period of the entry levy.

chapter.en: PART II PAYMENT OF ENTRY LEVY

heading.en: Entry levy for over-stay

text.en:
4A.—(1) Where a patron pays an entry levy for an over-stay period, the validity period of the entry levy shall be deemed to commence immediately after the expiry of the period in respect of which the person has paid an entry levy specified in section 116(1)(a) or (b) of the Act.
(2) In this regulation, “over-stay period” has the meaning ascribed to it in section 116(9)(a) of the Act.
[S 54/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
[S 637/2026 wef 31/12/2021]

chapter.en: PART II PAYMENT OF ENTRY LEVY

heading.en: Duty of casino operator to inform patrons of entry levy, etc.

text.en:
5. A casino operator shall, subject to such conditions as the Authority may think fit to impose —
(a)display prominently at each entrance to and exit from its casino premises, and at each place where the entry levy to enter its casino premises may be paid, a notice stating —
(i)the amount of the entry levy payable; and
(ii)such other information pertaining to the entry levy as the Authority may, by notice in writing, require; and
(b)provide clear information to every resident when he is paying an entry levy —
(i)about the validity period of the entry levy;
(ii)about the start of the validity period mentioned in regulation 4(1); and
[S 513/2019 wef 01/08/2019]
(iii)that, except where directed under section 117(4) of the Act, the entry levy paid is not refundable.

chapter.en: PART II PAYMENT OF ENTRY LEVY

heading.en: Prohibited transactions in relation to entry levy

text.en:
6. Without prejudice to the generality of section 116(3) of the Act, an indirect refund, remission or reimbursement of entry levy by a casino operator to a resident shall include —
(a)the giving of any right, privilege, discount or benefit to the resident (in addition to entry to the casino premises) by the casino operator or by any other person under an arrangement with the casino operator, in exchange for payment of the entry levy;
(b)any set-off of the entry levy payable by the resident —
(i)against any other amount (including any other entry levy) paid by the resident to the casino operator; or
(ii)against an amount paid by the resident to any other person; and
(c)the payment of any part of the entry levy on behalf of the resident by ––
(i)the casino operator; or
(ii)any other person on behalf of the casino operator.

chapter.en: PART III COLLECTION OF ENTRY LEVY

heading.en: Entry levy collection requirements

text.en:
7.—(1) The Authority may, by notice in writing given to a casino operator or an applicant for a casino licence, specify such minimum requirements in relation to the entry levy collection system applicable to the casino operator or applicant as the Authority may consider necessary (called in these Regulations the entry levy collection requirements).
(2) Upon the application of the casino operator or applicant, the Authority may, by notice in writing given to the casino operator or applicant, modify or waive any of the entry levy collection requirements, subject to such conditions as the Authority may impose.
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]

chapter.en: PART III COLLECTION OF ENTRY LEVY

heading.en: Duties of casino operator in relation to collection of entry levy

text.en:
8.—(1) Subject to these Regulations, a casino operator or an applicant for a casino licence shall —
(a)establish and implement an entry levy collection system which —
(i)satisfies the entry levy collection requirements; and
(ii)is approved by the Authority under regulation 9, 10 or 11, as the case may be (to the extent that such approval is required);
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(aa)[Deleted by S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(b)install at any entrance to or exit from the casino premises such electronic or other facilities as the Authority may, by a written direction given to the casino operator or applicant, require for the purposes of ascertaining whether the persons required to pay the entry levy have done so;
(c)keep such records as the Authority may require in relation to the collection of the entry levy and, where required to do so, produce to the Authority such records and permit the examination and taking of extracts or copies thereof, and answer any questions relating to those records; and
(d)comply with such other directions as the Authority may give from time to time for the purpose of securing the collection of the entry levy.
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(2) Nothing in this regulation shall derogate from the duty of the casino operator to comply with section 116(1) of the Act.

chapter.en: PART III COLLECTION OF ENTRY LEVY

heading.en: Approval of specified parts of entry levy collection system

chapter.en: PART III COLLECTION OF ENTRY LEVY

heading.en: Change proposed by casino operator to approved entry levy collection system

text.en:
10.—(1) A casino operator which intends to make a change to any part of its approved entry levy collection system that will deviate from the approved entry levy collection system must apply to the Authority for approval of the proposed change at least 30 days before the date of implementation of the proposed change, or within such shorter period as the Authority may allow.
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(2) Every application to the Authority under paragraph (1) shall contain —
(a)details of the proposed change, date and time of the implementation of the proposed change, reasons for the proposed change, the location (if any) of the proposed change and the period for which any part of the casino premises will be closed to implement the proposed change;
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(b)a statement by the person in charge of the operations of the casino that the proposed change will satisfy the entry levy collection requirements and comply with any direction given by the Authority in relation to the collection of entry levy and with these Regulations; and
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(c)such other information as the Authority may require to determine whether the proposed change will satisfy the entry levy collection requirements and comply with any direction given by the Authority in relation to the collection of entry levy and with these Regulations.
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(3) An approved entry levy collection system shall be revised to the extent that an application under this regulation (including the accompanying documents) is approved by the Authority.
(4) A casino operator shall ensure that the change to the part of the entry levy collection system is implemented in accordance with the proposed change as approved by the Authority under this regulation.
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]

chapter.en: PART III COLLECTION OF ENTRY LEVY

heading.en: Modification of entry levy collection requirements by Authority, etc.

text.en:
11.—(1) Subject to paragraph (3), where the Authority —
(a)modifies the entry levy collection requirements on the Authority’s own initiative;
(b)imposes on a casino operator any requirement mentioned in regulation 8(1)(b) or (c); or
(c)gives any direction to a casino operator mentioned in regulation 8(1)(d),
the casino operator must apply to the Authority for approval of any proposed changes to its approved entry levy collection system necessary to comply with the modified entry levy collection requirements or the requirement or direction of the Authority, as the case may be.
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(1A) The casino operator must submit the application under paragraph (1) not later than —
(a)30 days after the date the casino operator is notified of the modification of the entry levy collection requirements or the requirement or direction of the Authority, as the case may be; or
(b)such longer period as the Authority may allow.
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(2) The provisions of regulation 10(2), (3) and (4) shall apply to any application for a proposed change to the approved entry levy collection system under paragraph (1) as they apply to an application for a change proposed by a casino operator under regulation 10(1).
[S 637/2026 wef 31/12/2021]
(3) Where a casino operator considers that no change is required to its approved entry levy collection system —
(a)the casino operator may submit a statement by the person in charge of the casino operations that the approved entry levy collection system, without any change, continues to satisfy the entry levy collection requirements or the requirement or direction of the Authority, as the case may be; and
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(b)the Authority may, on the basis of that statement, allow the casino operator to dispense with the submission of an application under paragraph (1).
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(4) A modification to the entry levy collection requirements includes any addition to or variation or deletion of any entry levy collection requirement.
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]

chapter.en: PART IV PAYMENT OF ENTRY LEVY TO SINGAPORE TOTALISATOR BOARD

heading.en: Payment of entry levy to Board

text.en:
12.—(1) Subject to paragraph (2), all entry levies collected by a casino operator in any calendar month shall be paid to the Board under section 116(2) of the Act not later than 15 days after the end of that month.
(2) The Board may, in a particular case on the application of a casino operator, extend the time for payment.
(3) The entry levy shall be paid to the Board by an electronic funds transfer from the casino operator’s bank account to a bank account designated by the Board.
(4) All costs incidental to the payment of the entry levy to the Board shall be borne by the casino operator.

chapter.en: PART IV PAYMENT OF ENTRY LEVY TO SINGAPORE TOTALISATOR BOARD

heading.en: Furnishing of returns to Board

text.en:
13.—(1) Every casino operator shall, in respect of every calendar month, furnish to the Board a return in such form and manner as the Board may require, not later than 7 days after the end of the month (or part thereof) to which the return relates, except that the first return shall relate to the period beginning on the day the casino licence commences and ending on the last day of the month in which the casino licence commences.
(2) Every return furnished under paragraph (1) shall contain the following information:
(a)the total amount of entry levies collected for that month, specifying the amount comprising entry levies paid under section 116(1)(a) of the Act and the amount comprising entry levies paid under section 116(1)(b) of the Act;
(b)the amount of any refund of entry levies made by the casino operator under section 117(4) of the Act in that month;
(c)the amount of any entry levy recovered from the casino operator under section 117(3) of the Act in that month; and
(d)a statement by an employee authorised by the casino operator that the information in the return is true and accurate.
(3) Any person who ceases to be a casino operator in any calendar month shall, not later than 7 days after so ceasing, furnish to the Board a final return in such form and manner as the Board may require containing the information referred to in paragraph (1) in respect of that part of that month during which that person was a casino operator.

chapter.en: PART IV PAYMENT OF ENTRY LEVY TO SINGAPORE TOTALISATOR BOARD

heading.en: Power to obtain information

text.en:
14.—(1) The Board may, by notice in writing, request a casino operator to furnish such further information relevant to a return under regulation 13 or the amount of entry levies paid to it as the Board may require.
(2) Any casino operator which has been given a notice under paragraph (1) shall comply with the request in such manner and within such time as the Board may specify in the notice.

chapter.en: PART IV PAYMENT OF ENTRY LEVY TO SINGAPORE TOTALISATOR BOARD

heading.en: Auditor

text.en:
15.—(1) A casino operator shall engage, at its own expense, an auditor who shall be a public accountant to conduct an audit and make a report in respect of every quarter of a calendar year on the entry levies collected by the casino operator for that quarter.
(2) The auditor engaged under paragraph (1) shall in every such report state whether, in his opinion —
(a)sufficient controls are in place to ensure that persons who are required to pay the entry levy have done so;
(b)the amount of entry levies collected by the casino operator has been collected and recorded correctly in accordance with law; and
(c)the amount of entry levies collected by the casino operator has been paid in full to the Board.
(3) The casino operator shall submit the auditor’s report to the Board not later than 30 days after the end of the quarter to which it relates.
(4) In this regulation, “public accountant” means a person who is registered or deemed to be registered under the Accountants Act 2004 as a public accountant.
[S 637/2026 wef 31/12/2021]

chapter.en: PART IV PAYMENT OF ENTRY LEVY TO SINGAPORE TOTALISATOR BOARD

heading.en: Refund for overpayment of entry levies

text.en:
16.—(1) Where a refund of money overpaid as entry levy has been directed under section 117(4) of the Act by the Chief Executive or an authorised person, the casino operator shall —
(a)if money has been overpaid by a resident, refund to the resident the amount so overpaid not later than 14 days after the date of receipt of the direction; and
(b)set off the amount so refunded against the entry levies payable by the casino operator to the Board for the calendar month in which the refund is made.
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(2) Any casino operator or resident wishing to make a claim for a refund of money overpaid as entry levy must submit to the Authority —
(a)a written application for the refund in the form provided by the Authority for this purpose; and
(b)such documents and information in support of the claim as the Chief Executive or an authorised person may require to determine the overpaid amount.
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(3) Where the Chief Executive or an authorised person rejects a claim, he must notify the claimant accordingly.
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]

chapter.en: PART V GENERAL PROVISIONS

heading.en: Persons or class of persons not required to pay entry levy

text.en:
17.—(1) For the purposes of section 116(5)(e) of the Act, the persons to whom that section shall not apply are specified in the Schedule.
[S 54/2013 wef 31/10/2013]
[S 637/2026 wef 31/12/2021]
(2) Any exempt person who enters any casino premises without paying an entry levy must not take part in any casino gambling or promotional game whilst he is in the casino premises.
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(3) If the condition in paragraph (2) is not complied with by any exempt person, the exemption in paragraph (1) shall cease to apply to that person from the time the person takes part in any casino gambling or promotional game in the casino premises.
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]

chapter.en: PART V GENERAL PROVISIONS

heading.en: Duties of licensed special employee in relation to entry levy collection system, etc.

text.en:
18.—(1) A licensed special employee shall not —
(a)make, authorise or permit any change to the entry levy collection system which results in the entry levy collection system not meeting the entry levy collection requirements or not complying with any direction given by the Authority in relation to the collection of entry levy or with these Regulations;
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(b)make any change to any specified part of the entry levy collection system without the authorisation of the casino operator; and
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(c)make, authorise or permit any change to any specified part of the entry levy collection system unless the approval of the Authority has first been obtained for the change.
[S 54/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(2) Any licensed special employee who contravenes paragraph (1)(a), (b) or (c) shall be liable to disciplinary action under section 93 of the Act.

chapter.en: PART V GENERAL PROVISIONS

heading.en: Power to give directions and take disciplinary action

text.en:
19.—(1) If any casino operator —
(a)has implemented, or made any change to, any specified part of the entry levy collection system —
(i)without obtaining the approval of the Authority in accordance with these Regulations; or
(ii)other than in accordance with the approval of the Authority; or
(b)has implemented any part (whether or not a specified part) of the entry levy collection system in a manner which fails to satisfy the entry levy collection requirements, any direction given by the Authority in relation to the collection of entry levy or these Regulations,
the Authority may give the casino operator such directions concerning the entry levy collection system as it thinks fit, including —
(c)in a case where the part of the entry levy collection system as implemented or the change nevertheless satisfies the entry levy collection requirements, any directions given by the Authority in relation to the collection of entry levy and these Regulations — a direction to submit without delay an application for approval under regulation 9, 10 or 11, as the case may be; or
(d)in any other case —
(i)a direction to reinstate without delay the part of the entry levy collection system as approved by the Authority; or
(ii)a direction specifying the action or actions required to be taken to satisfy the entry levy collection requirements, the direction given by the Authority in relation to the collection of entry levy or these Regulations, as the case may be.
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(2) Without prejudice to the right of the Authority to give directions under paragraph (1), any casino operator which —
(a)contravenes regulation 4(2), 5, 8(1), 10(1) or (4), 11(1), 12, 13, 15(1) or (3) or 16(1)(a);
(b)fails to comply with a notice of the Board under regulation 14(2); or
(c)fails to comply with a direction under paragraph (1),
shall be liable to disciplinary action under section 54 of the Act.

THE SCHEDULE
Regulation 17(1)
Persons or Class of Persons Not Required to Pay Entry Levies
1. Any person who is a holder of a Category C2 special employee licence performing the function authorised by his licence in or in relation to the casino or casinos specified in his licence.
2. Any person licensed as an international market agent or international market agent representative.
[S 54/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
3. Any registered medical practitioner, nurse or paramedic required to attend to or respond to medical emergencies within any casino premises.
4. Any person employed or engaged by the casino operator or by another person to carry out any of the following activities within the casino premises, and who is permitted by the casino operator to enter the casino premises for that purpose:
(a)the operation of any food or beverage outlet or retail outlet;
[S 60/2020 wef 28/01/2020]
(aa)the provision of a money-changing service by a person licensed under the Payment Services Act 2019 to carry on a business of providing that service;
[S 60/2020 wef 28/01/2020]
(b)the provision of construction, renovation, cleaning, maintenance or security services;
(c)the provision of entertainment;
(d)the provision of services ancillary to the operation of the casino, and which are approved by a designated officer of the Authority to be carried out within the casino premises;
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(e)the delivery of goods, currency notes and coins (whether of Singapore or of a foreign country) which are legal tender and circulate as money in the country of issue, and other things necessary for any of the purposes in sub‑paragraphs (a), (aa), (b), (c) and (d).
[S 534/2015 wef 04/09/2015]
[S 60/2020 wef 28/01/2020]
4A. Any person requiring entry into the casino premises to view any part of the casino premises in connection with an invitation by the casino operator to submit a tender for a contract to carry out any of the activities referred to in paragraph 4(a) to (e) within the casino premises, and who is permitted by the casino operator to enter the casino premises for that purpose.
[S 534/2015 wef 04/09/2015]
5. An associate of the casino operator who is carrying out his functions as an associate.
[S 513/2019 wef 01/08/2019]
6. An employee of an accounting or auditing firm engaged by a casino operator to provide accounting or auditing services to the casino operator who is designated by the firm as requiring entry to the casino premises in the course of providing such services.
[S 513/2019 wef 01/08/2019]
6A. A special auditor engaged under section 144A(2) or (2A) of the Act to conduct a special audit who requires entry to the casino premises in the course of conducting the special audit.
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
6B. An employee of a person referred to in paragraph 6A who is designated by the person as requiring entry to the casino premises in the course of conducting that special audit.
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
7. Any of the following persons acting in the discharge of their duties under the Act or any other written law:
(a)a public officer in the Ministry of Manpower acting in the discharge of his duties under the Employment of Foreign Manpower Act 1990 or the Workplace Safety and Health Act 2006, and designated by a Deputy Secretary to the Ministry of Manpower as requiring entry to the casino premises for that purpose;
(b)a Commercial Affairs Officer appointed under section 64 of the Police Force Act 2004, and designated by the Director of the Commercial Affairs Department as requiring entry to the casino premises in the discharge of his duties;
(c)an officer of the National Environment Agency acting in the discharge of his duties under the Environmental Public Health Act 1987 or the Smoking (Prohibition in Certain Places) Act 1992, and designated by the Chief Executive of the National Environment Agency as requiring entry to the casino premises for that purpose;
(d)an officer of the Singapore Food Agency acting in the discharge of his duties as an authorised officer under the Environmental Public Health Act 1987, and designated by the Chief Executive of the Singapore Food Agency as requiring entry to the casino premises for that purpose;
(e)an officer of the Building and Construction Authority acting in the discharge of his duties under the Building Control Act 1989, and designated by the Commissioner of Building Control as requiring entry to the casino premises for that purpose;
(f)an officer of the Building and Construction Authority acting in the discharge of his duties under the Building (Strata Management) Act 2004, and designated by the Commissioner of Buildings as requiring entry to the casino premises for that purpose;
(g)an officer of the Monetary Authority of Singapore acting in the discharge of his duties under the Banking Act 1970, the Financial Services and Markets Act 2022 or the Payment Services Act 2019, and designated by an Executive Director of the Monetary Authority of Singapore as requiring entry to the casino premises for that purpose;
(h)an officer of the Board designated by the Chief Executive of the Board as requiring entry to the casino premises for the performance of his functions and discharge of his duties under the Act;
(i)a member of the Council or the secretary or any officer of the secretariat to the Council appointed under section 155(2) of the Act, acting in the discharge of his duties under the Act;
(j)a member of the Authority, or a member of a committee appointed by the Authority under section 27(1) of the Gambling Regulatory Authority of Singapore Act 2022, acting in the discharge of his duties under the Act or the Gambling Regulatory Authority of Singapore Act 2022;
(k)a member of a Patron Dispute Committee appointed under section 112(4) of the Act acting in the discharge of his duties as such;
(l)any other public officer or officer of a statutory body requiring entry to the casino premises for the performance of his functions and the discharge of his duties and who is approved by a designated officer of the Authority to enter for that purpose.
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
8. Any psychologist, social worker, trained counsellor or other professional in social services requiring entry to the casino premises to provide aid in relation to problem gambling, and who is approved by a designated officer of the Authority to enter for that purpose.
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
9. Any person whose entry to the casino premises is required by —
(a)an inspector;
(b)an officer from a law enforcement agency; or
(c)any of the individuals referred to in paragraph 7(l) or 11,
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
for the purpose of enforcement of any written law or prosecution of any offence under any written law, or to facilitate or enable the inspector, officer from a law enforcement agency or individual to perform his functions and responsibilities and the discharge of his duties, and who is approved by a designated officer of the Authority to enter for that purpose.
[S 54/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
10. Any person whose entry to the casino premises is required by an inspector, a member of the Patron Dispute Committee or the Authority for the purpose of determining any patron dispute, and who is approved by a designated officer of the Authority to enter for that purpose.
[S 54/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
11. Any other person requiring entry into the casino premises for the performance of his public functions and the discharge of his public duties, and who is approved by a designated officer of the Authority to enter for that purpose.
[S 54/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
12. Any member of a delegation, led by an individual referred to in paragraph 11, and who is approved by a designated officer of the Authority to enter for that purpose.
[S 54/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
[S 637/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
Note:
In this Schedule, “designated officer of the Authority” means the Chief Executive, a Deputy Chief Executive of the Authority or a Director of the Authority.
